description: This file defines an abstract class 'MaterialsProviderV2' within the AWS SDK for PHP, related to cryptographic materials management including key size support, key wrapping, and decryption functionalities.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: An abstract class implementing cryptographic material provider interface for AWS SDK, supporting key size validation, IV generation, and abstract methods for key wrapping and decryption.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size (in bits) is supported for AES encryption based on predefined supported sizes.

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the wrap algorithm used by this provider.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt an encrypted content encryption key (CEK) using provider-specific logic.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Abstract method for generating a content encryption key (CEK) based on provided parameters.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates an initialization vector (IV) using OpenSSL functions specific to the provided cipher name.
